texts.preamble: S.Sivakumar vs The Secretary To Government on 6 December, 2017 Author: S.M.Subramaniam Bench: S.M.Subramaniam In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras Dated : 06-12-2017 Coram The Honourable Mr.Justice S.M.Subramaniam W.P.No.10002 of 2010 And M.P.No.2 of 2010 1.S.Sivakumar 2.T.Kannan 3.S.Ravindran 4.P.Ponmurugan 5.K.Vasudevan 6.K.R.Surendran 7.N.Thangaraj 8.M.S.Mohammed Iqbal 9.P.Elango .. Petitioners -vs- 1.The Secretary to Government, Health and Family Welfare Department, Fort St. George, Chennai-600 009. 2.The Secretary to Government, Municipal Administration and Water Supply Department, Fort St. George, Chennai-600 009. 3.The Director of Public Health and Preventive Medicine, (State Food Authority), No.359, Anna Salai, Chennai-600 006. S.Sivakumar vs The Secretary To Government on 6 December, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/153797418/ 1 4.The Director of Municipal Administration, Chepauk, Chennai-600 005. .. Respondents Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, praying for the i For Petitioners - Mr.S.Ilamvaludhi. For Respondents - Mrs.K.Bhuvaneswari, Government Advocate. Order The relief sought for in this writ petition is for a direction to direct the respondents to issue Course Completion Certificate to the writ petitioners and appoint the writ petitioners as Food Safety Officers.
texts.facts: Order The relief sought for in this writ petition is for a direction to direct the respondents to issue Course Completion Certificate to the writ petitioners and appoint the writ petitioners as Food Safety Officers.
texts.arguments: Section 37 of the said Act, provides Food Safety Officer. As per the said provision, the Commissioner of Food Safety shall, by notification, appoint such persons as he thinks fit, having the qualifications prescribed by the Central Government, as Food Safety Officers for such local areas as he may assign to them for the purpose of performing functions under this Act and the rules and regulations made thereunder.
